# Capture-path hazards (generated by src/scripts/make_tables.py)

Device: reSpeaker XVF3800 4-Mic Array, firmware 2.0a, usb-audio, DSP-processed 2ch (beamformed; not raw 4-mic).

Run `channel-compare-20260915-220026-81553a`, git `03d8e8aa2507`, 4 known utterances played through the room speaker and decoded with the pipeline's own STT model.

| input to the recognizer | mean WER |
|---|---|
| channel 0 alone | 0.050 |
| channel 1 alone (chosen) | 0.025 |
| downmix of both (what a 1-channel open produces) | 0.250 |

Worst downmix failure: reference 'Can you hear me?' decoded as "What's going on here, me?" (WER 1.00), while channel 1 gave 'Can you hear me?'.

## Is the array's echo canceller being fed?

Log sweep, normalized cross-correlation with lag search; correlation floor (no playback) ncc 0.021.

| condition | channel | peak ncc | lag ms | tail ratio | rms |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| control_no_playback | 0 | 0.018 | 321.44 | 0.238 | 0.06037 |
| control_no_playback | 1 | 0.021 | 79.50 | 0.220 | 0.02352 |
| jieli_usb_speaker | 0 | 0.320 | 38.88 | 0.042 | 0.21131 |
| jieli_usb_speaker | 1 | 0.326 | 38.88 | 0.025 | 0.65942 |
| xvf3800_own_output | 0 | 0.034 | 31.69 | 0.269 | 0.00109 |
| xvf3800_own_output | 1 | 0.061 | 86.81 | 0.200 | 0.03388 |

- jieli_usb_speaker: strongest on ch1 (ncc 0.326, lag 38.88 ms, acoustic path); ch0 lower by 1.0x

- xvf3800_own_output: probe not detected on either channel (floor 0.021)

- The array-output condition transduced no sound (nothing is connected to the 3.5 mm jack), so its null result is no evidence either way; see results/NOTES.md.
